meta.purpose: One page per quarter of Guneku, carrying only what the Fondom's own records establish about it. A quarter with nothing recorded gets a page that says so, and an invitation to help fill it. No overview, history, market or institution is written here that is not already in a reviewed record.
meta.canonicalSource: src/lib/quarters.ts — GUNEKU_QUARTERS_27, the settled 27-quarter list. This registry does not add to it, rename anything in it, or reorder it.
meta.linkRule: Every link below was found by reading the record, not by matching the quarter's name against text. Short names make text matching unsafe: 'Fun' matches the ordinary word, and 'Kai' matches HRH Akam M. of Kai, the Fon of a different fondom, in the tributes record. Each link therefore carries the sentence that justifies it.
meta.emptyRule: 17 of the 27 have no reference in any record that puts their name beside the word 'quarter'. Their pages stay empty rather than being filled with plausible-sounding text. An empty page is a true statement about the archive.

quarters.name: Ngong
quarters.note: Ngong keeps a market of its own, which is separate from Ngon — the name of the village market day. The two are different things and are deliberately not spelled alike.

links.label: Guneku Agro CIG
links.evidence: The development register describes it as a "Community-owned agricultural enterprise at Ngong Quarter".

links.label: Rescue at the Ngong stream, and the water shortage behind it
links.evidence: The record is about the stream at Ngong and the village water supply.

links.label: Proposals of HRH Fon Fomuki, GUDECA AGM 2016
links.evidence: Proposes "use the existing Ngong market for a daily market" — the Fondom's own record of a market at Ngong.

links.label: The Guneku Traditional Council
links.evidence: The register records a councillor as "Secretary, Guneku Traditional Council; quarter head of Fun", and another as "President, Fun Quarter Traditional Council; represents Fun on the Guneku Traditional Council".

links.label: The FUN electricity project
links.evidence: The development register carries a "FUN electricity project", toward which GUDECA Europe contributed in 2025.

links.label: Quarter council elections across Guneku
links.evidence: Records that a councillor was elected to represent "the people of Nyang quarter in the Guneku traditional council", and that the elections "went on well" in Nyang.

links.label: The quarter council elections
links.evidence: Records the electoral commission touring "upper, lower and central Guneku" so villagers could elect their quarter councils. The record uses these as areas of the village; it does not name Central Guneku as a quarter in its own right.
